referenceFunction.generalComment: The shares are based on the current situation in Germany for the mix of UO2 and MOX fuels, assuming that 30% of the core of 2 BWRs are MOX and that at the beginning/end of the commercial operation of the reactors no MOX were/will be loaded. Hence, the indication of data validity inputted in "TimePeriod" only says that the shares represent the knowledge available today of the fuel management for German BWRs.; UUID: 91c6a4b1-ee93-3e0e-8ed1-ab9fc2099edf
